newsitem.title: GERMANY: Audi says sales up, optimistic for '97.
newsitem.headline: Audi says sales up, optimistic for '97.

text.p: Audi AG, the luxury-car unit of Volkswagen AG, said Friday its first-quarter sales had risen slightly to five billion marks ($2.9 billion) and it remained optimistic for higher results for the full year.
Audi said vehicle deliveries during the first three months of the year rose 18.5 percent to 137,100 units, while deliveries in Germany rose 13 percent to 59,094 units.

Audi, making the information public for the first time in its internal company magazine released Friday, said it remained optimistic for the balance of 1997, based on the start to the first three months of the year.
